content: पर {%a.%} [पॄ-भावे-अप्, कर्तरि अच्-वा] (Declined optionally like a pronoun in <ab>nom.</ab> <ab>voc.</ab> <ab>pl.</ab>, and <ab>abl.</ab> and <ab>loc.</ab> <ab>sing.</ab> when it denotes relative position) .²1 Other, different, another; see पर {%m.%} also. .²2 Distant, removed, remote; अपरं भवतो जन्म परं जन्म विवस्वतः <ls>Bg. 4. 4</ls>. .²3 Beyond, further, on the other side of; म्लेच्छदेशस्ततः परः <ls>Ms. 2. 23</ls>, <ls n="Ms.">7 158</ls>. .²4 Subsequent, following, next to, future, after (usually with <ab>abl.</ab>); बाल्यात् परामिव दशां मदनोऽध्युवास <ls>R. 5. 63</ls>; <ls>Ku. 1. 31</ls>. .²5 Higher, superior; सिकतात्वादपि परां प्रपेदे परमाणुताम् <ls>R. 15. 22</ls>; इन्द्रियाणि पराण्याहुरिन्द्रियेभ्यः परं मनः . मनसस्तु परा बुद्धिर्यो बुद्धेः परतस्तु सः .. <ls>Bg. 3. 42</ls>. .²9 Highest, greatest, most distinguished, pre-eminent, chief, best, principal; क्षत्रात् परं नास्ति <ls>Bṛ. Up. 1. 4. 11</ls>. न त्वया द्रष्टव्यानां परं दृष्टम् <ls>Ś. 2</ls>; <ls>Ki. 5. 18</ls>; परतोऽपि परः <ls>Ku. 2. 14</ls> ‘higher than the highest’; <ls n="Ku.">6. 19</ls>; <ls>Ś. 7. 27</ls>. .²7 Having as a following letter or sound, followed by (in <ab>comp.</ab>). .²8 Alien, estranged, stranger. .²9 Hostile, inimical, adverse, .²10 Exceeding, having a surplus or remainder, left over; as in परं शतम् exceeding or more than a hundred. .²11 Final, last. .²12 (At the end of <ab>comp.</ab>) Having anything as the highest object, absorbed or engrossed in, intent on, solely devoted to, wholly engaged or occupied in; परिचर्यापरः <ls>R. 1. 91</ls>; so ध्यानपर, शोकपर, दैवपर, चिन्तापर <ab>&c.</ab> .{@-रः@} .²1 Another person, a stranger, foreigner; <ab>oft.</ab> in <ab>pl.</ab> in this sense; यतः परेषां गुणग्रहीतासि <ls>Bv. 1. 9</ls>; <ls>Śi. 20. 74</ls>; see एक, अन्य also. .²2 A foe, an enemy, adversary; उत्तिष्ठमानस्तु परो नोपेक्ष्यः पथ्यमिच्छता <ls>Śi. 2. 10</ls>; <ls>Pt. 2. 158</ls>; <ls>R. 3. 21</ls>. .²3 The Almighty; तावदध्यासते लोकं परस्य परचिन्तकाः <ls>Bhāg. 3. 32. 8</ls>. .{@-रम्@} .²1 The highest point or pitch, culminating point. .²2 The Supreme Spirit; तेषामादित्यवज्ज्ञानं प्रकाशयति तत् परम् <ls>Bg. 5. 16</ls>. .²3 Final beatitude; असक्तो ह्याचरन् कर्म परमाप्नोति पूरुषः <ls>Bg. 3. 19</ls>. .²4 The secondary meaning of a word. .²5 (In logic) One of the two kinds of सामान्य or generality of notion; more extensive kind, (comprehending more objects); {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} (पृथ्वी is पर with respect to a घट). .²6 The other or future world; परासक्ते च वस्तस्मिन् कथमासीन्मनस्तदा <ls>Mb. 6. 14. 55</ls>. {%Note%}:-- The <ab>acc.</ab>, <ab>instr.</ab> and <ab>loc.</ab> singulars of पर are used adverbially; {%<ab>e. g.</ab>%} .³({%a%}) परम् .²1 beyond, over, out of (with <ab>abl.</ab>); वर्त्मनः परम् <ls>R. 1. 17</ls>. .²2 after (with <ab>abl.</ab>); अस्मात् परम् <ls>Ś. 6. 24</ls>; <ls>R. 1. 66</ls>, <ls n="R.">3. 39</ls>; <ls>Me. 102</ls>; भाग्यायत्तमतः परम् <ls>Ś. 4. 17</ls>; ततः परम् <ab>&c.</ab> .²3 thereupon, thereafter. .²4 but, however. .²5 otherwise. .²6 in a high degree, excessively, very much, completely, quite; परं दुःखितोऽस्मि <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 most willingly. .²8 only. .²9 at the utmost. .³({%b%}) परेण .²1 farther, beyond, more than; किं वा मृत्योः परेण विधास्यति <ls>Māl. 2. 2</ls>. .²2 afterwards; मयि तु कृतनिधाने किं विदध्याः परेण <ls>Mv. 2. 49</ls>. .²3 after (with <ab>abl.</ab>) स्तन्यत्यागात् परेण <ls>U. 2. 7</ls>. .³({%c%}) परे .²1 afterwards, thereupon; अथ तेन दशाहतः परे <ls>R. 8. 73</ls>. .²2 in future.
